title: Legal AI Document Review Operations
problem_statement: A legal AI product team needs to estimate clause-review workload, rare-clause QA coverage, and human capacity without treating automated labels as final legal judgments.
questions: Where is QA issue prevalence highest?
How should rare clauses be sampled?
hypotheses: Rare clauses require disproportionate QA effort.
Review time varies by contract type.
recommendations: Guarantee minimum QA coverage for rare, high-consequence clauses.
Keep qualified legal review as the final decision point and monitor annotation drift.
